contexts.text: The father of all that play on the harp and organ () = the truths and goods of faith.

(Celestial and spiritual things) are signified by two instruments, the harp and the organ... The organ is an instrument intermediate between a stringed one and one that is blown into; and therefore by it is signified spiritual good.
With stringed instruments and the organ () = from truths and the derivative good.
Trumpets, organs, etc., sound from a like blowing or influx of air according to their forms.
The organist with whom I dwelt...
